caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers standing on four turned legs with stretchers connecting the legs near the base. The furniture is composed of two main sections: an upper section with five drawers arranged in three horizontal tiers (two small drawers on the top row, and three larger drawers below) and a lower section with three smaller drawers. Each drawer has brass-colored ornamental handles or keyholes. The wood appears to have a reddish-brown grain, with lighter and darker variations for texture. The legs are bulbous and turned, featuring decorative shapes, and the stretchers have a curved, ornate design. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: High Chest of Drawers
